title: Beyond English-Centric LLMs: What Language Do Multilingual Language Models Think in?

bias_targets.methodology: Using the logit lens method to calculate the probability distribution of generating tokens in different languages (e.g., English, Japanese) across intermediate layers during translation, repetition, and cloze tasks.

Prompting models with questions that have different correct answers depending on the cultural context (e.g., the starting month of the academic school year in Japan vs. America) and observing intermediate layer predictions using the logit lens method to identify biases inherited from the dominant pre-training language.
